mapper.select: SELECT id,name,sku,price_cents,currency,status FROM product WHERE id=#{id} AND status='active' AND category_id IN (SELECT id FROM category WHERE enabled=1)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_order (version,created_at,updated_at,order_number,access_token_hash,customer_name,email,phone, shipping_address,currency,subtotal_cents,shipping_cents,total_cents,status,payment_status, expires_at,paid_at,internal_note) VALUES (1,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),#{row.order_number},#{row.access_token_hash}, #{row.customer_name},#{row.email},#{row.phone},#{row.shipping_address},#{row.currency}, #{row.subtotal_cents},#{row.shipping_cents},#{row.total_cents},'pending_payment','unpaid', DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 30 MINUTE),NULL,'')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM customer_order WHERE order_number=#{number} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,product_id,product_name,sku,unit_price_cents,quantity,line_total_cents FROM order_item WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id,payment_number,method,amount_cents,currency,status,provider_reference,paid_at,created_at FROM payment_record WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_order SET status='paid',payment_status='paid',paid_at=#{paidAt}, version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='pending_payment' AND payment_status='unpaid' AND expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
UPDATE payment_record SET status='refunded',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND status='succeeded'
